parameters.content: ## Scheduled & On-Demand Discovery\nFetches from official zero-auth company feeds (Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby) and hackathons (Devpost). Bounded to 10 items per dispatch. Structured fields mapped in code with zero LLM tokens. Preserves tiered trust: corroborated (company feeds) vs attributed (Devpost) vs unverified (fee/credential risk signals). Drops non-internship/job/hackathon items. Projects to matching profiles and triggers evaluation.
